title: Cabinet Hardware Cabinet Pull 3-Inch Solid Brass Traditional Style | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade bathroom cabinets and drawers with cabinet hardware built from solid brass. This 3-inch cabinet pull (handle) delivers a distinctive, transitional look—contemporary lines with traditional design elements—so you can coordinate a complete cabinet hardware collection and other versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Solid brass cabinet pull for daily use on cabinet doors and drawers
- Transitional bathroom hardware styling (contemporary + traditional elements)
- Cabinet-mount installation; mounting screws/hardware included
- Offered in many designer finish options to coordinate your space
- Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs:
- Product type: Cabinet pull / cabinet handle
- Material: Brass
- Style: Traditional
- Mounting type: Cabinet mount
- Dimensions: 3.9-inch L x 1.6-inch H x 0.9-inch W
- Projection: 1-inch
- Product weight: 0.8 lb
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included items: Cabinet pull and all installation hardware

Search terms: cabinet hardware collection, transitional bathroom hardware, versatile bath accessories.

This wide variety of solid brass knobs and pulls will enhance any kitchen or bathroom furnishings.  Small changes go a long way to spruce up any room.  Coordinate these knobs and pulls with other Allied products to compliment your home.
